title: PM E‑DRIVE Scheme Incentives and Deployments (as of July 2026)
summary: The PM E‑DRIVE scheme carries a total outlay of ₹10,900 crore. By 22 July 2026 it had incentivised 2,322,878 EVs across categories and reimbursed ₹2,281.94 crore to OEMs. An additional ₹2,000 crore has been allocated for EV public‑charging stations, with ₹689 crore approved for 6,562 chargers.

title: PARIVARTAN Scheme MoUs with OEMs
summary: The Ministry of Road Transport and Highways signed MoUs with 11 OEMs—including Tata Motors and Mahindra & Mahindra—under the PARIVARTAN scheme to supply cleaner trucks and buses in Delhi‑NCR. The scheme was approved on 3 June 2026 with a total outlay of ₹9,585 crore.

title: PLI‑ACC Agreement – Battery Manufacturing Capacity Commitment
entity: Reliance New Energy, Ola Electric, Rajesh Exports
summary: Three companies—Reliance New Energy Limited, Ola Electric Mobility Private Limited and Rajesh Exports Limited—signed a Program Agreement under the PLI‑ACC scheme on 28 July 2022, committing to create ~95 GWh of private‑sector ACC battery capacity and receive incentives under the ₹18,100 crore programme.

title: Roads Reimagined Report – EV Market Growth and OEM Expansion
summary: The ‘Roads Reimagined’ report (5 August 2026) documents a ~46‑fold increase in EV sales since 2016, exports rising from USD 1.2 million (2020) to USD 84 million (2024), and highlights capacity expansions by Tata Motors, Mahindra, TVS and others. It also notes Suzuki’s inaugural BEV ‘e VITARA’ launch in August 2025 and FY 2025 EV ecosystem investment of > USD 1.4 billion.

title: Ola Electric receives revised ACC PLI timeline and up to ₹7,240 crore incentives
summary: The Ministry of Heavy Industries approved a revised timeline for Ola Cell Technologies under the Advanced Chemistry Cell Production Linked Incentive scheme, granting Ola Electric access to incentives of up to ₹7,240 crore through 2031 and enabling the company to target 6 GWh of battery cell capacity by the end of the current quarter.
